result.description:
Position: Accountant (General)
Type: Full-time
Employer: Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd
Location: Laverton North VIC 3026
Salary: $110,000 p/a
About the Business:
Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd is a leading Australian meat processing, wholesale and export company specialising in the sourcing, processing, packaging and distribution of premium halal-certified meat products. The company supplies a wide range of fresh and frozen beef, lamb, mutton, goat and poultry products to domestic wholesalers, retailers, food service providers and international export markets. With a strong reputation for quality, reliability and strict adherence to Australian food safety and halal certification standards, Hilal Meat fosters a collaborative, values-driven workplace culture that emphasises integrity, continuous improvement, team support and a commitment to excellence in everything we do.
About the Position:
The Accountant (General) plays a vital role in supporting the financial integrity and strategic growth of Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd. Reporting to senior management, this position is responsible for managing core financial operations, delivering accurate reporting and analysis, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing insightful financial guidance to support informed business decisions in a dynamic meat processing and export environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Preparing and analysing financial statements including balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements to provide a comprehensive view of the company’s financial performance.
Developing budgets and financial forecasts to assist with business planning and effective financial management.
Ensuring compliance with tax laws and regulations through the preparation and filing of tax returns, management of tax payments and handling of audits.
Conducting internal and external audits to verify the accuracy of financial records and maintain regulatory compliance.
Maintaining accurate financial records, including general ledger management, bank statement reconciliations and recording of financial transactions.
Analysing financial data to identify trends, assess performance and deliver insights to management for strategic decision-making.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
At least a bachelor or master degree or higher qualification in accounting (or at least five years of relevant experience)
A minimum of one year’s experience as an accountant.
Strong technical skills in financial reporting, budgeting, tax compliance, auditing, record-keeping and financial analysis, with proficiency in relevant accounting software.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, high attention to detail, strong communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
result.title: Accountant (General)

result.description:
N.B. & L.J. Lewis Trading as Lambnchampers Partnership is seeking applications for Agricultural and Horticultural Mobile Plant Operator in Mooralla VIC.

The Agricultural and Horticultural Mobile Plant Operator is responsible for the safe, efficient, and competent operation of agricultural and horticultural mobile plant and associated equipment. 

Key Responsibilities:
Mobile Plant Operation
-  Operate agricultural and horticultural mobile plant including, but not limited to, tractors, loaders, harvesters, sprayers, mower conditioners, rotary hay rakes, seeders and associated attachments
-  Transport crops, soil, fertilizers, and equipment between work areas
-  Operate machinery safely in varying terrain and weather conditions
-  Ensure plant and equipment are used only within the scope of training, licences, and authorisations
Equipment Maintenance
-  Conduct pre-start checks and routine inspections of machinery and equipment
-  Perform basic servicing, cleaning, and minor maintenance tasks
-  Identify, report, and document mechanical faults, defects, or safety issues promptly
Work Health and Safety (WHS)
-  Comply with all workplace health and safety legislation, policies, and procedures

MYAC Resources is currently seeking experienced Sheet Metal Workers to join our growing network of leading Australian employers across Perth, Western Australia.

About the Role
As a Sheet Metal Worker, you'll play a key role in the fabrication, assembly and repair of precision sheet metal components used across a variety of manufacturing, engineering and industrial projects.
Working in modern, well-equipped workshops, you'll be part of a professional team delivering quality workmanship while maintaining the highest safety standards.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Fabricating and assembling sheet metal components to specification 
• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings, technical plans and fabrication details 
• Cutting, folding, bending, rolling and shaping sheet metal 
• MIG and TIG welding where required 
• Operating fabrication equipment including press brakes, guillotines, rollers, punches and other workshop machinery 
• Measuring, marking and preparing materials for fabrication 
• Repairing, modifying and installing fabricated components 
• Conducting quality inspections to ensure finished products meet engineering specifications Maintaining workshop equipment and ensuring a clean, organised work environment 
• Working safely in accordance with all workplace health and safety procedures 

About You
To be successful in this role, you'll have:
• Trade qualification as a Sheet Metal Worker, Metal Fabricator or equivalent recognised trade qualification
• Previous experience in sheet metal fabrication 
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and fabrication plans 
• Experience operating fabrication machinery and workshop equipment 
• Strong fabrication, measuring and welding skills 
• High attention to detail with pride in producing quality workmanship 
• Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment 
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills 
• Strong commitment to workplace safety and quality standards 

Highly Regarded
While not essential, the following experience will be highly regarded:
• MIG and TIG welding experience 
• Stainless steel and aluminium fabrication experience 
• Experience working in manufacturing, mining or heavy industrial environments 
• Forklift Licence 
• Overhead Crane experience 
• Current Australian Driver's Licence 
• Experience with precision fabrication and custom metalwork 

Employer Sponsorship Available

MYAC Resources has extensive experience connecting skilled tradespeople with genuine long-term employment opportunities across Australia for suitably qualified candidates, employer sponsorship is available, subject to employer approval and Australian migration requirements.
Whether you're already in Australia or planning to relocate, we can help connect you with employers seeking skilled Sheet Metal Workers.

What's on Offer
• Permanent full-time position

• Long-term career stability with established Australian employers 
• Modern workshop facilities and quality equipment 
• Ongoing training and career development 
• Supportive, safety-focused team environment 
• Employer sponsorship available for eligible candidates 
• Opportunity to build a long-term career in Australia 

Why Join MYAC Resources?
MYAC Resources specialises in connecting skilled tradespeople with leading employers across Australia's manufacturing, engineering, mining and industrial sectors. We don't just recruit people—we help build long-term careers. From your initial application through to placement and ongoing support, our experienced recruitment team is committed to helping you succeed. If you're a skilled tradesperson who takes pride in quality workmanship and wants to work with reputable Australian employers, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss.
